ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets in-person. Registration restricted to MAS through Jan 5. This course will open to students in the first stage of the BSA/MAS program at 9:30 am Jan 6. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
